exposure: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) activity (inactive vs. active)
outcome: Longitudinal serum levels of soluble Flt1 (sFlt1)
cohort: 163 pregnant patients diagnosed with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE).
finding: Pregnant patients with SLE who developed preeclampsia had higher sFlt1 levels and sFlt1:PlGF ratios and lower PlGF levels, with some of these changes detected as early as the second trimester, while SLE activity did not significantly affect the longitudinal behavior of these angiogenic markers.
